name: Shadcn UI Dashboard
summary: Admin dashboard template with 20+ page layouts, 50+ shadcn/ui components and 50 copy-paste blocks for Next.js and React.
description: Production-ready shadcn admin dashboard template built with Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4 and TypeScript. Ships five dashboards (ecommerce, CRM, banking, real estate, logistics), 20+ pages, TanStack data tables, Recharts charts and drag-and-drop kanban, plus a blocks library (charts, stat cards, sign-in forms, sidebars, page layouts) that copies into any shadcn/ui project or installs via the shadcn CLI.
